title: Jazzy Smoky German Sevaiiya Tagine
description: A smoky, silky, energizing German dish featuring sevaiiya and sashimi-cut cucumber, all cooked in a tagine pot for a satisfying one-pot meal.
instructions: Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat and pour 3 tbsp olive oil into the base.
Add 2 tbsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp smoked salt to the oil, stirring until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in 200 ml vegetable broth and 1 tbsp soy sauce, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add 200 g sevaiiya, stirring until the vermicelli is coated and begins to soften, about 3 minutes.
Fold in 200 g sashimi-cut cucumber slices, letting them steam in the broth for 2 minutes.
Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp parsley, and 2 tbsp dill, adjusting seasoning to taste.
Reduce heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 15 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Remove from heat, sprinkle optional 50 g vegan feta on top, and serve hot straight from the tagine.
